children: Private Bank announced the hiring of Teresa Radzinski from Bank of America to strengthen relationships with ultra-high-net-worth clients, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters.
Radzinski will join from Bank of America

, where she was a managing director at the private bank advising families, private foundations, universities and faith-based organizations. Based in Jacksonville, Florida, Radzinski will focus on clients with more than $500 million in net worth, said the memo, signed by Chris Biotti, Citi's Private Bank head for North America.
